verdict.rationale: Siskind Susser is an immigration law firm, so published flat fees or a priced service menu is a fair question to ask of it. Nothing in the evidence pack shows any published price, flat fee, or priced service menu on the firm's site. The cited pages cover its startup practice, O-1 dependents, its client mix, and a free trial of its Visalaw AI product, none of which are legal-service prices.

support.subject: As a founder, I can see real prices before I talk to anyone — published flat fees or a priced service menu on the provider's own site
